mission.title: Back to the Pods
mission.description: Escort a Zion Redpill that wants to be plugged back into the Matrix.

phase.briefing:
One of the Zion Redpills has had a change of ... heart. He wants to be re-inserted into the Matrix. While we can legally do this, we would rather not get into a confrontation with Zion over the issue.
Meet with Achernar and bring him to one of our Agents for reprocessing.

enter.say: The target is located in one of these rooms. Do whatever you can to avoid combat with the guards!

objective.text: Lead Achernar out of the area

phase.briefing: Take Achernar to Agent Voss for reprocessing.

enter.say: Agent Voss is waiting for you.

objective.text: Lead Achernar to Agent Voss to be re-processed
